scene: EXPLICIT CONTINUATION: Chapter 3 or 5, a storm night inside the authored north-ridge watchtower outside Drezen. Devarra sent 'Come up.' because it was a bad night for climbing; the Commander climbed soaked through the rain and ducked under her lifted wing. She lies around the whole tower floor, her body the wall and her wing the roof, warmer than any hall in Drezen; the Commander sits against her flank, hot as a banked hearth. She said she will not bite, it is not the day, and explained she once lay alone through such a storm and found it dull, and wanted to know whether it would still be dull with a thing beside her she could frighten: 'It is not. Sleep.' Continue: she does not let the Commander sleep yet. The wet clothes come off against the heat of her hide; she draws the Commander into the hollow beneath her lowered wing. A RETURN encounter after the first bite night. Predatory and possessive, food-and-fear words, amused by nerve. No bite, no tariff, no fire on the Commander. Only Devarra and the Commander; the storm stays outside the wing.
